title: Marked INAR model and the rough Hawkes--Heston limit
abstract: arXiv:2611.29565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a discrete-time Monte Carlo algorithm for the rough Hawkes-Heston model based on a nearly unstable marked integer-valued autoregressive (INAR) process. We implement the algorithm with a block fast Fourier transform (FFT) scheme that evaluates the excitation convolution in $O(N\log^2 N)$ operations per path on an $N$-bin grid. We prove joint convergence in law of the spot variance, log price and common marked point measure to their rough Hawkes-Heston limits. We prove convergence of European call and put option prices, as well as convergence of arithmetic Asian and down-and-out put option prices to their continuously monitored values. For European options, the one-year implied volatility smiles computed from the grid transform approach the continuous affine reference across four roughness levels. translated_title: 带标记的INAR模型与粗糙Hawkes–Heston极限
translated_abstract: 我们基于一个近不稳定的带标记整值自回归（INAR）过程，为粗糙Hawkes-Heston模型开发了一种离散时间蒙特卡洛算法。我们采用分块快速傅里叶变换（FFT）方案实现该算法，在N个格点的网格上每条路径以O(N log² N)次运算评估激励卷积。我们证明了即期方差、对数价格和公共带标记点测度依分布联合收敛到其粗糙Hawkes-Heston极限。我们证明了欧式看涨和看跌期权价格的收敛性，以及算术亚式期权和向下敲出看跌期权价格向其连续监测值的收敛性。对于欧式期权，在四个粗糙度水平上，由网格变换计算得到的一年期隐含波动率微笑均逼近连续仿射参考结果。在相同三个网格上的蒙特卡洛实验将算术亚式期权和向下敲出看跌期权价格与更精细网格的参考值进行了比较。
tldr: 本文基于近不稳定的带标记INAR过程与分块FFT方案，为粗糙Hawkes-Heston模型提出了一种高效离散时间蒙特卡洛算法，并严格证明了方差、价格及各类期权价格向其连续极限的收敛性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an efficient discrete-time Monte Carlo algorithm for the rough Hawkes-Heston model based on a nearly unstable marked INAR process with a block FFT scheme, and proves convergence of spot variance, prices, and various option prices to their continuous limits.
